supporting_observations.claim: The alerted activity is visible: the domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake.
A network logon by nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 to the domain controller preceded the creation, and the account-creation event uses the same logon ID.
nora.blake added ext.rwong to the Freelancers group shortly after creation, using the same logon ID as the creation event.
The actor, ext.<name> account naming pattern, and Freelancers group placement match the documented help-desk account-creation practice, making this consistent with a legitimate action.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert window. The supplied collection status reports this outage; it does not prevent review of the visible domain-controller account events.
The supplied records show the creation and a Freelancers group addition, but do not establish the account's complete effective group membership or subsequent use.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested or approved for creation.
Whether ext.rwong had any additional group memberships or privileges beyond the recorded Freelancers addition.
Whether ext.rwong was used after creation during the alert window.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm the account request or authorization with nora.blake or the applicable help-desk record.
Obtain authoritative group-membership and privilege information for ext.rwong at creation, including relevant group-change audit events.
Review domain-controller authentication and account-use events for ext.rwong through the end of the alert window.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect UI launched on WS-NBLAKE-01 and loaded a Cisco-signed library. The inventory says no VPN is in use, but these records do not establish that a VPN connection occurred; investigate separately and do not use this to decide the account-creation alert. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
